regime_context: Gate_helps is true (absolute-trend discipline has cut drawdown historically), but the headline Big Pharma theme is crowded (z 1.48) with one_narrative=false and absorption 0.34 — a multi-theme, defensive-skewed regime, not a single dominant narrative. Rotation leader 'Memory/HBM' is ineligible (trend-gate off), so the theme lead is not tradable; the eligible ranks are dominated by crowded healthcare/defensive staples.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff from crowded defensives/healthcare toward the 'Retail' theme (rank 6, broad 0.905, eligible) — the observable condition is Retail closing its momentum gap vs Big Pharma (PPH) by 150bps of relative performance over a rolling 10-day window while staying trend-gate eligible; that would retire the watch and mark a cyclical rotation.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-scoring eligible trend-gate theme with full breadth (1.0) and durable trend (durability_bar 0.85, confirming val_state). The trend discipline historically controls drawdown on this market, so staying with the strongest eligible trend is a risk-aware lean. However crowding (z 1.48, crowded=true) is a size-down caution and I have no edge claim beyond the gate.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z 1.48 with absorption only 0.34 means Big Pharma leadership is narrow and reflexivity-prone; a crowded defensive theme can mean-revert sharply if the macro backdrop flips toward risk-on AI/cyclical re-acceleration.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 5% or more over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW is eligible with high durability (0.81) and near-full breadth (0.933), corroborating the broader healthcare leadership behind Big Pharma. The trend-gate is on and this market's history shows the gate reduces drawdown, so an overweight direction on the eligible healthcare cluster is consistent with risk discipline. Crowding (z 1.56) again cautions size but is not a fade signal.
theses.dissent: Healthcare cluster is crowded and its dominance may be a defensive flight rather than durable leadership; any re-risk move could see healthcare underperform cyclicals quickly.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 5% or more over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Staples EW is eligible with durability_bar 0.82, trend hurst, and broad internal participation (0.818), placing it in the same defensive trend cohort as healthcare. With gate_helps true, staying long the eligible trend cohort is the detector's only validated value — a drawdown-control orientation rather than a return call. Extreme crowding (z 1.99) is a strong size-down warning, not a reason to fade.
theses.dissent: Staples is the most crowded theme in the entire universe (z 1.99); defensive crowding this extreme has historically coincided with weak forward risk-adjusted returns even when the trend is intact.

falsifier.text: XLP lags SPY by 5% or more over the next 20 trading days
